name: Mavren Fein
description: Mavren Fein is a vampire hierophant of the Legion of Dusk, the highest ranking member of the Church of Dusk, devoted to Saint Elenda.

timeline.summary: Mavren Fein, in the rapture of his Blood Fast, destroys the navigator's tools and steers the ship to shore by faith alone.
timeline.quote: In the rapture of his Blood Fast, he destroyed the navigator's tools and steered the ship to shore by faith alone.

citation.text: Mavren Fein, Dusk Apostle (Ixalan Promos, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elenda resorts to dark magic and immortality, searches for centuries, returns to teach her Rite to nobles, then sails west again.
timeline.quote: Elenda resorted to dark magic and took on the burden of immortality until the Immortal Sun could be retrieved once again.

citation.text: "Elenda of Garrano", section "Vampire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vona and Mavren Fein overpower Kumena and throw him from the Tower of Triumph.
timeline.quote: They quickly threw him out of the window of the Tower of Triumph.

citation.text: "Orazca", section "The race for Orazca". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With Mavren Fein, Vona reaches Orazca and throws Kumena from the Tower of Triumph.
timeline.quote: threw Kumena out of the window of the Tower of Triumph

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elenda reappears, tells followers they are free, and says she will become the sun's sentinel; Mavren Fein punishes Vona and the Legion leaves Ixalan.
timeline.quote: the Legion left the continent of Ixalan

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A starving, crazed Mavren Fein stumbles up to Fort Adanto, proclaiming his faith in Saint Elenda.
timeline.quote: I have conquered the waves and death itself, praise Saint Elenda!

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Mavren Fein throws down his ruined navigational tools, claiming faith alone brought him to land.
timeline.quote: a crushed sextant, a broken compass, and a menagerie of other ruined navigational tools

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Mardia recognizes Mavren Fein and has the guards open the gate to let him in.
timeline.quote: Hierophant Mavren Fein?

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Smelling blood, Mavren Fein scales the fort wall and attacks a guard but cannot pierce his armor; the guards kick him off and Mardia pins him.
timeline.quote: He began to claw his way up the sides of Fort Adanto

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Mardia has Mavren Fein led to the holding cells and tells him prisoner Manuel will break his fast at dusk.
timeline.quote: Manuel killed a compatriot in a fight over a game of cards

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Mavren Fein tells Manuel the legend of Saint Elenda, the nun who guarded the Immortal Sun and became the first vampire.
timeline.quote: She was born mortal, a warrior nun charged with her brothers and sisters of faith to guard the Immortal Sun in the mountains of Torrezon.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Mavren Fein breaks through the cell wall and feeds on Manuel, ending his Blood Fast.
timeline.quote: A breath later, his teeth were at the neck of the criminal, and the coppery scent of blood filled the air.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Clear-minded again, Mavren Fein reveals his crew is dead and says he will continue the mission regardless.
timeline.quote: But I intend to continue our mission all the same.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vona and Mavren Fein tackle Kumena and wound him.
timeline.quote: The vampires scratched and bit, and one of their swords sliced a long line into Kumena's side.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vona and Mavren each find what they sought, a conqueror and a savior.
timeline.quote: Vona sought a conqueror. Mavren sought a savior. Both found what they sought . . .

citation.text: Profane Procession (Rivals of Ixalan Promos, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At the Sanctum of the Sun she refuses Mavren Fein's request to retrieve the vanished Immortal Sun, tells the vampires they are free, and rebukes Vona.
timeline.quote: Elenda refused, telling the vampire that they were finally free from their ancient duty

citation.text: "Elenda of Garrano", section "Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kumena reaches the Sanctum of the Sun but is bested by Vona and Mavren Fein and thrown out of the tower, then saved by Tishana.
timeline.quote: he was saved in time by his former teacher, Tishana

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "The Fight for Control". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vona cries out that the Immortal Sun is gone.
timeline.quote: The Immortal Sun is gone!

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Saint Elenda arrives and asks whether the Immortal Sun is gone.
timeline.quote: Is it gone, children of night?

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Elenda accepts the Sun is gone for good and tells her followers they are free.
timeline.quote: No, my child. We are free. It is gone forever.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Elenda demands to be taken to Queen Miralda.
timeline.quote: Take me to Queen Miralda,

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Mavren Fein slices Vona's cheek for insulting Elenda.
timeline.quote: Do not speak ill of a living saint!

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: The three vampires leave into the night.
timeline.quote: the three vampires exited into the night.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Vona refuses to return to Torrezon empty-handed (non-canon Legion of Dusk ending).
timeline.quote: I will not return to Torrezon empty-handed,

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Rivals of Ixalan Magic Story Alternate Endings" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Saint Elenda tells Vona to claim Orazca and sails east.
timeline.quote: Claim Orazca for your own. I will sail to the East.

citation.work: Rivals of Ixalan Magic Story Alternate Endings
authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Rivals of Ixalan Magic Story Alternate Endings" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Elenda tells her followers that immortality was not the purpose of her gift but protection, and that she will be sentinel of the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: Elenda answered that immortality was not the purpose of her gift, but protection.

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The Age of Ever-Flowing Blood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mavren Fein punishes Vona for speaking ill of the living saint.
timeline.quote: Vona denied her, but Mavren Fein punished Vona for speaking ill of the living saint.

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The Age of Ever-Flowing Blood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The New Phyrexian Invasion forces captured vampires to join the Sun Empire against it.
timeline.quote: However, before the war could continue, the New Phyrexian Invasion started, and the captured Mavren Fein's vampires had to join with the Sun Empire to defend the plane.

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The Age of Ever-Flowing Blood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elenda becomes a vampire after the Immortal Sun is stolen and teaches her Rite to the nobles; Mavren Fein is an early convert.
timeline.quote: Mavren Fein was one of her early converts

citation.text: "Mavren Fein", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mavren travels to Ixalan to find Orazca, guiding his ship by faith alone during his Blood Fast.
timeline.quote: He guided his ship to shore by faith alone

citation.text: "Mavren Fein", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mavren falls under the thrall of the demon-spawn Zotz at the Temple of Aclazotz and goes slowly mad.
timeline.quote: Mavren fell under the thrall of the demon-spawn Zotz

citation.text: "Mavren Fein", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Alante's party battles Mavren and Zotz at the temple; Zotz's death breaks its hold on Mavren and Alante takes the Hierophant's Chalice.
timeline.quote: When Zotz was killed, its death finally broke its hold on Mavren

citation.text: "Mavren Fein", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mavren joins Vona and reaches Orazca, throwing Kumena out of the Tower of Triumph.
timeline.quote: threw Kumena out of the window of the Tower of Triumph

citation.text: "Mavren Fein", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Saint Elenda reappears and tells her followers they are free from their ancient duty; Mavren punishes Vona for speaking ill of her, and the Legion leaves Ixalan.
timeline.quote: Mavren Fein punished Vona for speaking ill of the living saint

citation.text: "Mavren Fein", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Fein returns to Ixalan, is captured by the Sun Empire, and is released under Huatli's command to invoke the Elder Dinosaurs against the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: was captured by the Sun Empire

citation.text: "Mavren Fein", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ghalta rampages among the Phyrexians and Mavren's vampire legionnaires follow in its wake, dealing serious damage to the invaders.
timeline.quote: Mavren commanded his legionnaires to follow in the elder dinosaur's wake

citation.text: "Mavren Fein", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Invasion Fein is promoted to Pontifex but Vona breaks away to form a splinter church.

citation.text: "Mavren Fein", section "Aftermath of the Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Huatli tells Mavren the trap was part of her plan, since bait is necessary when hunting a great beast.
timeline.quote: Bait is necessary.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli's company and released vampire auxiliaries leave Pachatupa along the river while the army stages a diversion.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli rejects the idea of being mere survivors and resolves to fight to the top of the Winged Temple to call the elders.
timeline.quote: Then we will fight to the top and call upon the elders.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.
